dna.opening: a glowing amber ring draws itself on in a dark studio, AURELIA sharpens letter by letter, and the camera flies through the ring
dna.bigMoment: the live website splits into floating layers with cyan wireframes and labels while the camera circles around them, then snaps back together
dna.ground: dark navy studio with amber light beams, amber-violet-cyan glows, drifting dust and a faint reflective grid floor
dna.music: cinematic minimal electronic with a deep pulse, a riser into the layer split and a warm swell at the end, about 100 BPM
